title: Blade Components, Slots aur Attributes
objectives: Anonymous aur class-based components ka farak samajhna
Default aur named slots use karna

sections.heading: Component kya hai?
sections.body:
Component ek reusable Blade tukda hai, jaise alert, card ya button. Ek baar banao aur har jagah `<x-naam />` se use karo. Do tarah ke hote hain:

- **Anonymous component** – sirf ek Blade file (`resources/views/components`).
- **Class-based component** – ek PHP class (`app/View/Components`) aur uska view.

callout.text: Zyada tar kaam anonymous components se chal jaata hai. Class tab banao jab component ko logic ya data tayyar karna ho.

sections.heading: Anonymous component: alert
sections.body: `@props` batata hai ki component kaunse data leta hai. Defaults bhi de sakte ho.

code.code: Order ho gaya. Shukriya!

explain: `type="danger"` – normal string. `:message="$errorText"` – colon lagane se PHP variable/expression.
`@props` mein jo naam hain woh variable ban jaate hain (`$type`, `$message`). Baaki attributes `$attributes` mein.
`$attributes->merge(['class' => ...])` – bahar se aaya `class="mt-3"` aur component ki class mil jaati hain.
Tag ke andar ka content `{{ $slot }}` mein aata hai.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Card with named slots
sections.body: Card ka title aur body alag slots mein. Named slot na diya to dikhega nahi, isliye `isset` jaisa check ya default de sakte ho.

sections.heading: Class-based component
sections.body: Jab component ko apna logic chahiye, to class banao. Constructor ke public properties view mein apne aap milti hain.

code.code:
<?php

namespace App\View\Components;

use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Illuminate\View\Component;

class Price extends Component
{
    public function __construct(public int|float $amount) {}

    public function formatted(): string
    {
        return 'Rs. ' . number_format($this->amount, 2);
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('components.price');
    }
}

explain: `make:component Price` class aur view dono banata hai.
Class ka public method (`formatted`) view mein `$formatted()` se call hota hai.
Naam `Price` -> tag `<x-price />`. Do shabdon ka naam (`OrderCard`) -> `<x-order-card />`.

sections.heading: Folders mein components
sections.body: Components ko folder mein rakhne par dot se use karte hain:

versionDiff.heading: Components: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13
versionDiff.intro: Anonymous aur class-based components, slots aur attributes teeno versions mein same kaam karte hain.

items.13: Same as 11. Component syntax mein koi badlaav nahi.

errors.error: Unable to locate a class or view for component [alert]
errors.cause: Component file/class nahi mili ya naam galat hai.
errors.fix: `resources/views/components/alert.blade.php` hona chahiye (ya class `App\View\Components\Alert`). Naam ka spelling check karo.

errors.cause: `@props` mein `type` nahi likha ya tag mein pass nahi kiya.
errors.fix: `@props(['type' => 'info'])` mein default do ya tag mein `type="..."` do.

errors.error: Component mein variable mein string ki jagah PHP value chahiye par text aa raha hai
errors.cause: `:` lagana bhool gaye (`amount="$x"` string hota hai).

debug.body: Components ki list aur cache ke liye:

code.code:
php artisan view:clear
php artisan make:component forms.button --view

tasks: `<x-alert>` component banao (type aur message ke saath, class forward ho)
`<x-forms.input>` banao jo label, input aur error dikhaye
Ek class-based `<x-price>` banao jo number ko Rs. format mein dikhaye

quiz.q: Component mein PHP variable pass karne ke liye kya likhte hain?
quiz.why: Colon wala `:prop` PHP expression leta hai.

options: Bahar se aaye attributes ko component ke attributes se jodta hai
quiz.why: Forward kiye gaye `class` jaise attributes component ke apne attributes ke saath mil jaate hain.
Folder ko dot se likhte hain: `<x-forms.input />`.

interview.q: Anonymous aur class-based component mein farak?
interview.a: Anonymous sirf Blade file hota hai. Class-based mein PHP class bhi hoti hai jo logic aur data tayyar kar sakti hai.
Component ke accepted data aur unke default values batata hai. Baaki attributes `$attributes` mein jaate hain.
Component ke andar ka content. Default slot `$slot` hai, aur `<x-slot:name>` se named slots bante hain.

interview.q: Attributes component mein kaise forward hote hain?
Component naam se tag kaise banta hai?
interview.a: Class `OrderCard` ya file `order-card.blade.php` -> `<x-order-card />`. Subfolder ke liye dot: `<x-forms.input />`.

summary: `@props` aur `:prop` se data, slots se content.
`$attributes->merge()` se class jaise attributes forward hote hain.
Logic chahiye to class-based, warna anonymous.
